hotel.name: Azure Bay Hotel
hotel.description: A comfortable city hotel for leisure and business guests.

check_in.details: Check-in is available from 2:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability.

check_out.details: Check-out is by 11:00 AM. Late check-out is subject to availability and may incur an additional charge.

wifi.details: Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and common areas.

pool.details: The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool, open daily from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

parking.details: Complimentary on-site parking is available for hotel guests.

breakfast.details: Breakfast is served daily in the hotel restaurant from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.

cancellation_policy.summary: Cancellation policies vary depending on the reservation rate.
cancellation_policy.details: Please check the cancellation terms associated with your selected rate at the time of booking. Some rates may be non-refundable.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: A comfortable room suitable for leisure or business stays.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: A larger room suitable for families, with extra space and amenities.

rooms.name: Suite
rooms.description: Spacious accommodation with a separate living area.
